about_short_description.short_description: Refine is a react-based web application development platform that offers a wide range of software services.

product.name: Refine React Meta-Framework
product.description: A React-based meta-framework for building CRUD-heavy web applications like internal tools, admin panels, dashboards, and B2B apps.

product.name: Refine Data Providers and Connectors
product.description: Pre-built connectors for 15+ backend services including REST APIs, GraphQL, NestJS CRUD, Airtable, Strapi, Supabase, Hasura, Firebase, and others.

product.name: Refine UI Framework Integrations
product.description: Integration support for multiple UI frameworks including Ant Design, Material UI, Mantine, Chakra UI, Tailwind CSS, and Headless UI.

product.name: Refine Authentication and Authorization
product.description: Built-in support for authentication and fine-grained access control using widely accepted models like ACL, RBAC, and ABAC, with native integration for identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, Amazon Cognito, and Google Cloud Identity.

product.name: Refine Enterprise Edition
product.description: A self-hosted version of Refine designed for enterprise compliance, performance, and stability, offering priority support, training, and consulting services.
